### Note for Authors - Please Review 

<details>

EIP Editors are here to support authors, answer questions, and help resolve specific issues or blockers.

* Have a PR you’d like to discuss? Please add the PR number/link and your specific question or blocker in the comments. We’ll add it to the agenda for discussion.
* New EIP reviews follow the review queue and may be completed asynchronously. You do not need to attend Office Hours just to request a review.
* Have another EIP process question or topic you’d like to discuss? Please add it to the comments as well.

Authors are always welcome to join, ask questions, and participate in the discussion.

</details>

For ERCs#1907 (ERC-8348, Financial Lease) in the review queue: I can't join live this week, so leaving my two questions here. Answers on the PR are perfect.

1. The PR has been waiting on code-owner review since abcoathup's editorial review was addressed in July (CI green, up to date with master). What, if anything, is still needed to merge it as Draft?
2. A design issue was raised on Magicians this week (oracle staleness: pay() reverts while arrears and default still proceed): https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8348-financial-lease/29076/15. I've proposed a fix in the thread. Should it go in before the Draft merge, or in the next revision after it?
